data.name: Meghali
data.gender_notes: Meghali is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Megha (cloud) + Ali (borne). Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Megha' which means 'cloud'. In Hindu mythology, Megha is the Goddess of clouds and rain. This name is bestowed upon a girl born under the clouds or during rain. The name Meghali carries the meaning “Cloud-borne, Sky-borne” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Meghali usually hope their child will grow to embody cloud-borne, sky-borne and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name signifies a deep spiritual connection to the spiritual realms, reminding one of their inherent divinity and invoking a sense of inner peace and tranquility.
